issues.title: Eclipse magnetic draft rev4 (EXP-687), cycle-4 hole C4-1: PRED-095 card scored under a gentler DR-1 standard than our own B1-M-001 upper band — erratum-symmetry breach
issues.description: The PRED-095 card is scored under DR-1 with a "not excluded" consistency test and no CTL-1 discount, while our own B1-M-001 upper band is falsified under a detection test plus CTL-1, in the same draft. Under the card's own standard, our upper band at SPT tau 30/60 would NOT be falsified either. The card text restricts the claim to "during totality"; the rescuing fits are at 30-60 min lag, which is not during totality — at the lags the card text actually admits (tau 0-15), -17.8 nT is 4.1-7.7 SD from every fit. Net: under one consistent rule the card is "falsified as-if" exactly like our own upper band. This breaches the erratum symmetry obligation that is the reason this evaluation exists. Fix per curmudgeon recommendation: pick ONE DR-1 standard (recommended: eclipse-attributable fits (R3) + detection standard + CTL-1 discount, each side restricted to the lags its own text admits) and apply it to both the card and our band; rewrite operator_decisions.decision_5 consequence, labels_under_options, symmetric_labelling_options.option_A.consequences[1], and the EXP-687 newsworthy line accordingly. See monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/ECLIPSE-2026-08-12-MAGNETIC-RESULTS-proposal.c4.json hole C4-1 for full detail.

issues.description: C4-2: the lag-absorption argument (quadratic trend absorbs part of a lagged response) is applied to discount the quadratic-trend rejection of the dome's -10.9 baseline, but the same injection table shows a MISMATCHED template also attenuates — restate the x1.672 rejection within the dome's own timing bounds. C4-3: "absent at every station above 80% coverage" is true only on the dome's own coverage table (EBR, SPT), not on the ephemeris >80% set the draft reports side by side (which includes LER at 88% ephemeris) — narrow the headline claim. C4-4: "standard physics" in the headline/kernel is represented by whichever of two fitted proxies (sin(solar elevation) vs our own Sq proxy) fits best; our own Sq proxy actually fits worst, and the Ashour-Chapman geometry the hnote asked for is not computed — disclose both fits and compute the requested geometry or explain why not. C4-6: archiving the raw inputs (_meta.data_publication_state) is currently optional; it should be a PRECONDITION of the OTS stamp (decision_ots) because the manifest is the only way to re-derive results once BGS GIN replaces best-available files with definitive versions (EBR, CLF, KOU, part of GUI are still Variation data) — make archiving a precondition and add a pre-declared definitive-data re-run rule, without waiting for definitive data to stamp. See monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/ECLIPSE-2026-08-12-MAGNETIC-RESULTS-proposal.c4.json holes C4-2/C4-3/C4-4/C4-6 for full detail and recommended fixes.

issues.title: Eclipse magnetic draft rev4 (EXP-687), cycle-4 minor holes C4-5/C4-7/C4-8: card arithmetic off by 0.37 nT, A-vs-A-minus-null_mean convention mismatch, PRED-095 crypto_hash typo + PRED-TIER-1 date mismatch
issues.description: C4-5: -18.22 x 0.978 x (1-0.022) evaluates to -17.43 nT, not -17.8 nT as the draft states (-17.8 is -18.22 x 0.978 without the (1-0.022) factor) — the card center and its +/-2 band are inconsistent with the card's own formula; correct to -17.43 (band [-19.43,-15.43]) or flag the dome's own arithmetic error explicitly rather than repeating it as correct. C4-7: the draft mixes raw fit amplitude A (registered_prediction_scorecard.B1-M-001.as_if_DR1 / dome_favourable_findings / control_station_check) with A-minus-null_mean (prediction_level.PRED_095.card_scored_on_registered_component_H) for the same "lagged/eclipse-attributable H fit" quantity without labeling which is which — add explicit labels. C4-8: data/predictions.json PRED-095 crypto_hash field reads "ec411e88" but the card's published SHA256 on the dome page is "dc411e88b00bebf2..." (03-predictions.txt:1427) — typo, fix to dc411e88; separately PRED-TIER-1 registration_date is recorded as 2026-04-04 but the dome block carrying Tier 1 says "Registered: 2026-04-08" — reconcile. See monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/ECLIPSE-2026-08-12-MAGNETIC-RESULTS-proposal.c4.json holes C4-5/C4-7/C4-8.
